clues: This town sits on the north coast of a long island. Flat land lies by the sea, with steep hills close on all sides.
The year here splits in two clear parts, a wet part and a dry part, in this hot land near the sea.
In 1769, Portugal made this its main town on the isle. It then grew as the chief port of the land.
A massacre here drew the eyes of the world. Then a vote let this land break free and stand on its own.
Cristo Rei is a famed landmark here. It was built in the years when Indonesia ruled this land.
